name: Monsters and Me
source: In Monsters and Me, you play as Arthur, a teenager close to graduating high school with his friends. Everything was going well until suddenly Arthur gains the ability to see creatures, monsters, and other beings too outlandish to believe. It's up to you to decide how you go about your relationships with your so-called friends. It's up to you to decide who you remain close to, or rather, who you get closer to.
translation: 在《Monsters and Me》中，你将扮演即将与朋友们一起高中毕业的少年亚瑟。原本一切顺利，直到有一天，亚瑟突然能够看见各种生物、怪物，以及其他离奇得令人难以置信的存在。如何与那些所谓的朋友相处，由你决定。你要与谁保持亲近，又或者，要与谁变得更加亲密，也全由你选择。
